svg.text: Lay it out like this before you start
This is the arrangement every later picture uses. You sit at the bottom edge. Cable and card stay where they are until Parts 3 and 4.
Screen pin order, left to right: ____ ____ ____ ____
Clock stays in the bag today.
Jumpers in four rows, by colour
Count them now. Hunting for a missing wire at step 3 costs ten minutes of doubt.
Modules go along the top edge.
Power uses the rail pair along
board. If your board has one
rail pair only, turn it so that
Rows j to f (top half) hold the
columns. Rows e to a are
PocketBeagle 2, sockets up, USB-C port to the LEFT
Turned so P1 is the strip nearest the
breadboard. Pin 1 is then at the left end
of P1, by the USB-C port.
Find the tiny printed 1 and 2 there
Every wire that leaves P1 goes straight
